scope_limits: No measured PADP/CIR or original hardware/antenna calibration reproduction.
No real S1/S2, semantic wall/plate identification, 3 mm wall accuracy or RCS/Eq4 reproduction.
MAX scalar-power injection and angular envelope are phenomenological, not physical waveform superposition.
Connected grouping may chain distinct objects; anonymous association is not semantic recognition.
All default-study matched groups are two-station; single-station performance advantage is not established.
The representative fixed scenes do not prove all-geometry/high-noise/general robustness.
Historical fixture equality stays blocked; old source/raw data/screenshots remain unavailable.
Cross-engine full bit-exact numeric equality stays failed for the checked pair.
